content:
{'0': "Among the many new products Apple is launching this fall is the Apple Watch Series 12. Here are the four biggest rumored new features in this year's Apple Watch update."}

{'1': '#1: New chip (a real upgrade)'}

{'2': "The Apple Watch Series 9, 10, and 11 all essentially run on the same chip. However, according to rumors, this year's Apple Watch Series 12 will get a real chip upgrade."}

{'3': 'Macworld reported on the change:'}

{'4': 'The 2026 model has been identified as "Watch8," which points to a major hardware leap. For example, the Apple Watch Series 9, Series 10, and Series 11 were all grouped under "Watch7" due to their similarities. The "Watch8" family includes the N237, N238, and N240 models (the Apple Watch Series 12 with GPS and cellular, and the Ultra 4), and will feature a new CPU called the T8320.'}

{'5': 'The last time Apple introduced a truly new processor for the Apple Watch was with the Apple Watch Series 9 in 2023. That upgrade brought faster CPU and GPU performance.'}

{'6': 'As Apple brings Siri AI to the Apple Watch via watchOS 27, improved performance will be essential for future AI capabilities.'}

{'7': '#2: Battery life'}

{'8': 'Longer battery life is reportedly a major focus for the upcoming Apple Watch Series 12. Apple is said to be working on increasing the physical battery capacity of the device and improving energy efficiency in other ways.'}

{'9': 'As Apple continues to push features like sleep tracking on the Apple Watch, extending battery life has become a major priority for the company.'}

{'10': '#3: Brand new health features'}

{'11': 'According to Digitimes, Apple has submitted a new high blood pressure notification feature to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for approval.'}

{'12': "watchOS 26 introduced high blood pressure notifications to the Apple Watch for the first time. It remains unclear how this rumored new blood pressure feature will differ from the Apple Watch's existing capabilities."}

{'13': 'The current Apple Watch high blood pressure feature doesn\'t actually provide a blood pressure reading. Instead, it uses data collected by the Apple Watch\'s heart rate sensor to notify users when a "pattern of high blood pressure" is detected over a 30-day assessment cycle.'}

{'14': "It remains to be seen whether the Apple Watch Series 12 will have any other health upgrades. Apple is still working on a non-invasive blood glucose monitoring feature for the Apple Watch, but that's still years away from being ready."}

{'15': '#4: Brand new watch face'}

{'16': 'Bloomberg reported that Apple is developing a brand new Apple Watch face that\'s a "simplified version of the Modular Ultra design."'}

{'17': 'This is essentially a version of the popular Modular Ultra watch face from the Apple Watch Ultra, simplified for use on the standard "Series" watch.'}

{'18': 'This new modular watch face may eventually make its way to other Apple Watch models, but we expect it to be officially unveiled at the Apple Watch Series 12 launch event.'}

{'19': 'Bonus tip: What not to expect'}

{'20': "While there were once rumors that the Apple Watch Series 12 might add Touch ID support, it now appears that won't be happening."}

{'21': 'Instead, newer rumors suggest Apple has shelved the feature after determining that new health features and a larger battery were more important for the Apple Watch.'}

{'22': 'Summary of Apple Watch Series 12 new features'}

{'23': 'The Apple Watch Series 12 is expected to launch in September alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4.'}

{'24': 'Which new Apple Watch features are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.'}

{'25': "If you don't want to wait until the Apple Watch Series 12, the Apple Watch Series 11 is currently on sale on Amazon for $100 off."}
